Hello world

} ``` ### After ```jsx filename="app/example.js" 'use client' import { useEffect } from 'react' export default function Example() { useEffect(() => { console.log('in useEffect') }) return

Hello world

} ``` ## Useful Links - [Server Components](/docs/app/building-your-application/rendering/server-components)
